reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in our DM (DH10RUL0002) to confirm the note: their Marrow Fieldworks pickup dock is now Dock 14, and I'll keep it private.

I didn't take any other action, since they said none was needed. I also didn't save it to GBrain: that's a shared knowledge base, so other people could see it there, which goes against "keep it between us." The note stays in our DM, where only Hollis and I can see it.

My first try at replying used `send_dm`, which couldn't find a member named "Hollis Mbeki", so I posted in the DM channel itself. That's where they wrote to me anyway, so the reply went to the right place.
